verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state the open-source version is a standalone system dependent only on PostgreSQL, with data plane and control plane components, confirming self-hostable core; community posts corroborate real-world use and licensing (AGPLv3/SSPL) discussions. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting setup/deployment guide, independent hands-on report of running the OSS stack, and clarity on which features (e.g., Profiles, MCP AI features) are excluded from the self-hosted edition.
